title: Released my free naturalist animal identification game
author: Prophysaon_Coeruleum
selftext:
Check it out:

[creaturefeature.gg](http://creaturefeature.gg)

Took inspiration from [maptap.gg](http://maptap.gg), which my family has been playing religiously for over a month. 

Let me hear your thoughts! 

\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
  
Started out with Opus 5.5 on ultracode, which ate up 2 5hr periods of my token budget, but I think it did a great job with the overall layout of the site. 

Text/copy throughout the site was terrible, it was AI-y to a T. Still AI-y in places, but controlled it a bit with some additional marketing passes and my own review. 

The site still feels a bit "slop" to me, but I will be cleaning it up and adding features as I go.

comments.author: ibuildtools
comments.body: Looks nice. I would keep spect ratio same for all images, so you don’t have layouts shift on the slider. Swiping on images doesn’t work well.

replies.author: Prophysaon_Coeruleum
replies.body: Thanks for the feedback on swiping! Good point on the aspect ratio.
